atlas_fit.current_problem: Atlas needs inspiration for an integrated private AI workspace without collapsing service, data, and authority boundaries.
atlas_fit.future_risk: A monolithic self-hosted workspace can combine chat, shell, email, documents, credentials, and agents into one high-impact compromise domain.

claims.claim: The repository documents a self-hosted workspace spanning chat, agents, research, documents, email, notes, tasks, calendar, local models, MCP, and tools.
Its broad integration is safe or compatible with Atlas without dedicated threat modeling and AGPL review.

excluded_classes: raw financial, legal, tax, insurance, mortgage, estate, brokerage, or account evidence

unresolved: Runtime behavior, security effectiveness, performance, and compatibility were not independently executed or benchmarked in this Mission.
